text:
Sam: Spike — prototyping a 'dithered burst' traffic generator to better emulate long-tail latency for kernel selection + KV warmups. Needs: QPS ramps, nested microbursts, controllable prefix/KV cache hit rates. What metrics and controls should we expose?

Jia: Capture p50/p90/p99/p999, but also per-op breakdowns (attention kernel, matmul, memory ops). KV hit/miss per request and per-token. Batch-size histogram and queue depth distribution.

Leo: +1. For reproducibility include a workload spec file (seed, distributions, hot-key ratios). Modes: replay (from traces) and stochastic (param-driven). :white_check_mark:

Sam: Rough spec sketch: 
```yaml
mode: stochastic
seed: 164873
qps_schedule:
  - {start: 0, qps: 50, duration_s: 60}
  - {start: 60, qps: 500, duration_s: 30, burst_dither: true}
microburst_profile:
  pattern: nested
  outer_period_s: 10
  inner_bursts_per_outer: 3
  inner_burst_qps_multiplier: 8
interarrival: pareto(alpha:1.5)
request_size_tokens: {dist: bimodal, small:0.6, small_tok:32, large_tok:512}
kv_profile:
  hot_key_scale: 0.8
  hot_key_churn_s: 300
  prefix_cache_hit_rate_target: 0.7
metrics: [p50,p90,p99,p999,per_kernel_counts,batch_size_hist,kv_hits]
```

Jia: Nice. For interarrival, add an option to dither burst edges (jitter) to avoid aligning with scheduler quantum. Also add a "warmup_hint" field to mark requests that should prime KV only (for staged warmups).

Leo: Batching heuristics: simulate both latency-first and throughput-first queues. Emulate greedy batching + bounded-delay strategies. Export per-batch latency and effective tokens/sec.

Sam: For kernel-selection regressions: run baseline vs candidate with same seed + workload spec. Compare per-op latency distributions and kernel invocation counts. If candidate increases p999 by >5% or increases matmul tail by >8% flag as regression.

perf-bot: scheduled run queued: `run-synth --spec=1765432100-spec.yml --cluster=perf-a --note="dithered-burst-proto"`

Jia: Observability: tag traces with synth.run_id, request.seq_in_burst, kernel_hint, kv_hit. Add flamegraphs sampled during p99 events and per-batch heatmaps.

Leo: For apples-to-apples we must: 1) pin model weights + quantization profile, 2) disable any adaptive autoscaling, 3) fix kernel selection RNGs. Store full run manifest (git sha, kernel commit, RT libs).

Sam: I'll land a minimal generator binary that emits both YAML spec and a condensed JSON summary of run metadata. Then we can hook into the eval dashboard. Who wants integration?

Jia: I'll own integration. Will add trace/span mapping and dashboard panels. ETA: tomorrow afternoon.

Sam: :thumbsup: Thanks — will iterate on burst-dither paramization (maybe add power-law tail knobs).

Leo: One last note: include a "chaos" toggle to randomly flip KV cache topology (simulate eviction storms). Good for exposing pathological kernel choices.

Sam: Great call. Adding to backlog.
